entities.name: Maurya Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Maurya Empire, a political institution in Pakistan during Achaemenid, Greek, and Mauryan Period (305 BCE–185 BCE). Grew from Darius I and Persian and Alexandrian Period. Led to the emergence of Ashoka and Ashoka's Rock Edicts carved at Mansehra and Shahbazgarhi in Pakistan.
